skill.name: ui-design-system
skill.description: Design guidance for the Physical AI Hub, including typography, colors, components, animations, and CSS organization.
skill.summary: Apply the Physical AI Hub visual system across interfaces.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged Markdown inline code spans as Ruby or shell backtick execution. Review found only CSS values, animation names, and file paths inside design documentation, with no executable command context or prompt injection evidence.

static_findings.snippet: - **Primary Accent**: `#2d7d6c` (Teal/Greenish) used in buttons and highlights.
- **Cards**: Glassmorphism effect (blur + transparency), rounded corners (`12px` or `16px`).
- **Inputs**: Rounded (`24px`), borderless or subtle border, focus rings.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks wrap a CSS linear-gradient value in Markdown documentation. There is no Ruby, shell, or command execution context.
The backticks wrap a CSS color hex value used as a design token. This is static prose, not executable code.
The backticks wrap a CSS text color value in a palette list. No command invocation or interpreter context is present.
The backticks wrap a CSS rgba border value in Markdown prose. The line describes styling, not shell execution.
The backticks wrap CSS pixel values for border radius. This is component styling guidance with no executable behavior.
The backticks wrap a CSS pixel radius for inputs. The snippet is documentation only and cannot execute commands.
The backticks wrap CSS transition timing values. The line documents animation style and contains no shell command syntax.
The backticks wrap keyframe names used by CSS animations. These identifiers are not commands and are not executed by the skill.
The backticks wrap a project file path referenced in CSS structure guidance. A Markdown file path does not create external command execution.
The backticks wrap a stylesheet path for Docusaurus overrides. The line is descriptive documentation and has no execution mechanism.
The backticks wrap a CSS module path in prose. No command execution, dynamic evaluation, or user input handling appears in the file.

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent interface styling for the Physical AI Hub. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear design rules for colors, typography, components, animations, and CSS files.
actual_capabilities: Defines the Physical AI Hub visual philosophy as premium, modern, dark, sleek, and futuristic.
Specifies Poppins typography with regular, medium, semi-bold, and bold weights.
Provides dark mode color values for background, accent, text, and borders.
Describes styling rules for buttons, cards, inputs, and dropdowns.
Lists animation patterns, including transition timing and keyframe names.
Identifies CSS files used for global styles, Docusaurus overrides, and component modules.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not complete component source code.
It is tailored to the Physical AI Hub and may need adaptation for other brands.
It does not include accessibility contrast testing or responsive layout rules.
It does not define design tokens in a machine-readable format.

use_cases.title: Align a New Feature Screen
use_cases.description: Use the theme rules to keep a new product screen visually consistent with the Physical AI Hub.

use_cases.title: Review Interface Styling
use_cases.description: Check colors, typography, cards, buttons, and animation choices against the documented system.

use_cases.title: Guide Documentation Styling
use_cases.description: Apply the same visual language to Docusaurus pages and supporting documentation styles.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Basic Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for a single interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the ui-design-system skill to this screen. Update colors, typography, buttons, cards, inputs, and spacing to match the Physical AI Hub style.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for a reusable component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this component against the ui-design-system skill. Identify mismatches in typography, accent color, border treatment, radius, and transition behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Theme CSS
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task for shared styling files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor the theme CSS using the ui-design-system skill. Keep global variables, Docusaurus overrides, and module styles aligned with the documented visual system.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-View Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task for a product workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-view Physical AI Hub workflow using the ui-design-system skill. Apply consistent component states, dark mode surfaces, motion patterns, and file organization.

output_examples.input: A dashboard page feels inconsistent with the Physical AI Hub.
output_examples.output: A review that recommends the dark gradient background, Poppins typography, teal accents, glass-style cards, subtle borders, and smooth hover transitions.

output_examples.input: A documentation site needs theme alignment.
output_examples.output: A styling plan that updates global CSS, Docusaurus overrides, and component modules while preserving the premium dark interface language.

output_examples.input: A dropdown menu needs visual polish.
output_examples.output: A component guidance response covering floating placement, animated slide-in behavior, shadow depth, rounded corners, and readable text treatment.

best_practices: Use the documented palette before adding new colors.
Keep component styling consistent across global CSS, documentation CSS, and module CSS.
Pair premium motion with readable text and clear focus states.
anti_patterns: Mixing unrelated fonts or color systems into the Physical AI Hub interface.
Using heavy animations that reduce responsiveness or distract from core tasks.
Changing shared CSS files without checking component and documentation impact.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps apply the Physical AI Hub design system to interfaces, components, animations, and CSS structure.

faq.question: Does it generate complete UI components?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance that an AI assistant can apply when creating or reviewing components.

faq.question: Which visual style does it define?
faq.answer: It defines a premium dark mode style with Poppins typography, teal accents, glass-style cards, and smooth motion.

faq.question: Can it help with Docusaurus styling?
faq.answer: Yes. It names a Docusaurus custom CSS file as part of the intended CSS structure.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility rules?
faq.answer: No. Add explicit accessibility checks for contrast, keyboard focus, and reduced motion when using this skill.

faq.question: Is there any command execution risk?
faq.answer: No evidence was found. The flagged backticks are Markdown formatting for CSS values and file paths.
